Race the bee: who lands patches on t27, a person or a bee

A dated snapshot of gHashTag/t27: merged pull requests by the Queen's bees and by people, the issues both lanes went for, and the open ones nobody has taken.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • GitHub GraphQL API, gHashTag/t27: pull requests closed in the window and every open pull request, with the issues each one closes
  • GitHub GraphQL API, gHashTag/t27: every open issue and its body, searched for a ## Boundary section
  • GitHub REST API, gHashTag/t27 git/matching-refs/heads/queen-: the bee branches on the remote
  • scripts/widget-data/race-the-bee.mjs: the snapshot, written to public/widgets/race-the-bee/data.json with its UTC time
